# Documents of testdata/placement (tools/mjml-reference/placement.mjs) that safe-mjml renders
# differently from MJML 4.18, checked by TestPlacement. Format: name: reason.
# Remove a line when the document matches MJML.

divider-in-group--misplaced--after-sibling: MJML divides a percentage width by the group's child width, a "123px" string, and writes width:NaNpx in the Outlook cell; safe-mjml writes no width (no NaN, Pierre's rule, docs/differences-from-mjml.md)
